concern: Skills follow the Agent Skills standard and are born from their own init.

conditions.test: an init that writes SKILL.md as a named pipe is reported, never read
conditions.because: It guards the POSIX hazard that reading a SKILL.md written as a FIFO blocks the check. On Windows no init can write SKILL.md as a FIFO, so there is no such hazard; the portable claim that a SKILL.md which is not a regular file is reported and never read holds there too and is shown on every platform by the case for an init that writes SKILL.md as a directory. linux-support and windows-support stay satisfied.
